steps.js: (async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.addLocalRepository(__REPO_PATH__); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 900)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ branch: s.status && s.status.branch.name, defaultBranch: s.defaultBranch }); })()

(async () => { window.__gitgood.actions.openDialog({ kind: 'create-pr', autoDraft: true }); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); const progress = s.ai['<pull request>']; if (progress && (progress.phase === 'done' || progress.phase === 'error')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); const bodyEl = document.querySelector('.dialog-body textarea'); const titleEl = document.querySelector('.dialog-body input:not([readonly])'); return JSON.stringify({ dialogKind: s.dialog && s.dialog.kind, title: titleEl ? titleEl.value : null, body: bodyEl ? bodyEl.value : null, calloutText: (document.querySelector('.dialog-body .callout') || {}).textContent || null }); })()
